English: Wellspring
A simple, hand-dug well lined with timber, providing the settlement with its first reliable access to fresh water.
Rain Cistern
A large, communal cistern collects rainwater, supplementing the towns supply and supporting greater trade and productivity.
Public Well
A stone-lined well at the center of the settlement, encouraging trade and gathering while improving civic order.
Draw Well
A deep, stone-lined draw well with pulley mechanisms, increasing water security and enabling urban expansion.
Stone Aqueduct
A masterwork of masonry, this stone aqueduct guarantees abundant, clean water and attracts merchants from afar.
Timber Aqueduct
A wooden aqueduct channels water from distant springs, allowing the city to thrive and supporting more advanced commerce.
Water Tower
A tall stone tower stores and distributes water across the city, enabling greater urban density and boosting trade.
Reservoir
A massive, engineered reservoir provides immense water storage, safeguarding against drought and supporting city growth.
Urban Fountain
A grand fountain in the city center serves as both a water source and a symbol of civic pride, attracting visitors and boosting prosperity.
Pumping Station
An advanced waterworks utilizing waterwheels and pumps to deliver water citywide, enabling a flourishing metropolis and unmatched trade.
